message: Scaffold Cargo project with clap CLI skeleton
Implement homeos.yml config parsing with serde
Implement homeos init command
Migrate from serde_yaml to yaml_serde
Refactor all unit tests to follow 3A pattern (Arrange / Act / Assert)
Implement `homeos cd` to launch a subshell in the default repo directory
Implement `homeos package list` to display packages from homeos.yml
Implement `homeos package add <pkg>` to create package directory and config entry
Implement `homeos package remove <pkg>` to remove config entry from homeos.yml
Add skeleton script generation to `homeos package add`
Add `homeos package enable <pkg>` command
Add `homeos package disable <pkg>` command
Add confirmation prompt with testable plan logic
Implement `homeos package install <pkg>...` command
Implement `homeos package update <pkg>...` command
Implement `homeos package uninstall <pkg>...` command
Implement `homeos package cat <pkg>` command
Implement state.yml parsing with serde for tracking installed packages
Enhance homeos init to generate .gitignore excluding state.yml
Enhance package install to record installed packages in state.yml
Enhance package uninstall to remove uninstalled packages from state.yml
Enhance package install to skip already-installed packages
Refactor run_action to update state.yml per package and continue on failure
Disable packages in homeos.yml after successful uninstall
Fix package add to preserve existing scripts in package directory
Add --all flag to package uninstall for bulk uninstall from state.yml
Fix package uninstall to ignore disabled status
Extend Plan with not_installed classification and load state for all actions
Implement full behavior matrix for install/update/uninstall plan classification
Refactor action from &str to Action enum
Enhance enable and disable to accept multiple packages
Enhance package remove to reject installed packages
